accepted.quote: H.R. 9330, the Earned Wage Access Consumer Protection Act establishes a disclosure framework for so called ``Earned Wage Access'' advances but does not appropriately include consumer protections to protect the users of such products from abuse, such as any caps on the associated costs.
accepted.bill: H.R. 9330, the Earned Wage Access Consumer Protection Act
accepted.rationale: The signers criticize the bill for failing to include adequate consumer protections such as caps on costs.
